info.name: Garments ERP - Yarn Complete API Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for all Yarn operations in Garments ERP & CRM.

Includes:
1. Authentication (Super Admin & Company Admin with auto-extracted tokens)
2. Yarn Master Catalog (CRUD, filtering by category/yarn_type, count, searching)
3. Supporting Masters (Yarn Counts, Color Shades, UOM, Company Yarn Types, Mills)
4. Yarn Procurement (Purchase Orders with schedules, authorization, live balance)
5. Godown Inventory (Live Stock Ledger, GRN Inwards, DC Outwards for Knitting/Dyeing)
6. Commercial Sales & Customer Returns
7. Knitting Production (Yarn consumption & planned vs issued reconciliation)

Environment / Collection Variables:
- base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8000
- access_token: auto-populated by login scripts
- company_id: 1
